Moriah Elementary School welcomed most students among Essex County in 2025-26 school year
L. H. Kang
Moriah Elementary School had the highest enrollment among Essex County schools, welcoming 371 students during the 2025-26 academic year, according to the New York State Education Department.
Data also showed that most of the students were white, representing 98.7% of Moriah Elementary School's total enrollment.
Among the 16 schools in Essex County, Ticonderoga Elementary School ranked second in enrollment numbers with 353 students, while Ticonderoga Junior-Senior High School welcomed 326 students and came in third in the 2025-26 school year.
Moriah Elementary School is part of Moriah Central School District, which roughly covers two schools within Essex County and has a main office in Port Henry.
In the previous school year, Ticonderoga Elementary School had the highest number of students among Essex County schools.
New York ranks second nationwide in K-12 public education spending, with current expenditures averaging $30,012 per student, nearly double the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
